summary: Master business case development and investment prioritization with ROI, DCF, scoring models, and executive-ready proposals. Enrol today.
lede: Business case development and investment prioritization gives project, portfolio, and finance professionals a structured way to assess funding proposals. It covers framing options, quantifying costs and benefits with ROI and discounted cash flow, and ranking initiatives through weighted scoring. Learners also practice benefits planning, risk-adjusted feasibility reviews, and executive recommendations to support funding decisions when budgets are constrained.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already contribute to budgets, proposals, or portfolio decisions and now need a more rigorous method for business case development and investment prioritization. Project Managers who prepare funding requests and scope business cases. PMO Analysts who evaluate proposals for portfolio governance. Portfolio Managers who rank initiatives under budget constraints. Finance Business Partners who validate financial assumptions and returns. Business Analysts who document options, benefits, and risks. Programme Managers who support investment decisions across multiple workstreams. Strategy Managers who connect proposals to strategic objectives. Functional Leaders who sponsor initiatives and defend investment choices. Investment Committee Secretariat staff who coordinate review packs and decisions. Operations Managers who justify process or technology improvements with value cases.
modules: Business Case Fundamentals and Decision Logic
Financial Appraisal with DCF and ROI
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software installed, ideally Microsoft Excel or an equivalent tool used in your organization. You should also be ready to work with sample business case templates, investment scoring sheets, and a short proposal from your own work context if available.
topics: Project finance, appraisal & public investment management
